scope.advance_rows: all exact-charge basic-packet rows in a radius-one neighborhood of any insertion seam; retained packets outside that neighborhood are fixed to the mapped B20 row
scope.hold_rows: all 65 canonical L*(X|H)+R* rows of center width at most five with exactly one H, hence charge one
scope.direct_width_six: all four literal compositions of mutable P2/P5 one-step words, with a contiguous radius-one two-packet slab from A17
scope.negative_scope_note: Seams are independent between rows (a superset of unit-speed moving seams). No radius-two rewrites, nonbasic phase packets, other HOLD placements, or mixed D4 caps are included.
